heading: What’s inside, for practices
title: The same system, built for how patients choose.

items.name: Weekly Pulse
items.text: A one page read on how your practice showed up this week, and the one thing to do next.

items.name: Lift Score
items.text: One number that shows whether your practice is getting easier to find.

items.name: AI Shortlist
items.text: Know whether AI assistants recommend your practice, and who they recommend instead.

items.name: Map Reach
items.text: Where your practice appears in Google Maps across the neighborhoods your patients come from.

items.name: Site Read
items.text: Make sure Google and AI tools describe your practice correctly.

items.name: Market Survey
items.text: See what nearby practices are doing before it shows up in your schedule.

items.name: Daily Presence
items.text: Google Business Profile posts that keep your practice active and current.

items.name: Review Desk
items.text: Review replies that stay warm and never confirm someone is a patient or mention their care.

items.name: Snapshot
items.text: Calls, direction requests and website clicks from Google, in plain language.

items.name: ClearView
items.text: Your social report: what posted, what patients engaged with and what changes next.
